reading.title: Mill Street Lofts: annual certificates and end of the affordability period

candidates.quote: This memo reports the status of the yearly owner certificates for Mill Street Lofts under the Regulatory Agreement dated June 14, 2011, and notes the upcoming end of the affordability period.
candidates.wording: reports the status of the yearly owner certificates

candidates.quote: The certificate for reporting year 2025 was due on March 31, 2026 and is marked not received.
candidates.wording: was due on March 31, 2026 and is marked not received

candidates.quote: A reminder notice was sent to the owner on April 2, 2026.
Under Section 5.1 of the agreement, the affordability period ends on December 31, 2026.
(a) Staff will send a second notice asking for the 2025 certificate by May 15, 2026.
candidates.wording: Staff will send a second notice
candidates.value: second notice for 2025 certificate by May 15 2026
